zh.text: 退一步，我再次主張 2010 年代（零利率下限）是偏離常態。利率的水平和波動性似乎已恢復到 *典型* 水平。

en.text: taking a step back, I’d once again argue that 2010s (ZLB) was the departure from norm. both the level and vol in rates seems like it has returned to *typical* levels.

zh.text: Stephanie Link指出本週因$NVDA和熱通膨而波動劇烈。然而GDP達3.5%令人鼓舞，EPS上漲28%。未來一週有零售EPS值得關注。

en.text: Stephanie Link notes a wild week with $NVDA and hot inflation. Yet GDP at 3.5% is encouraging, and EPS up 28%. Big week ahead with retail EPS.

zh.text: $NDX 1997 年納斯達克回調與當前回調均發生在對重大技術浪潮高度樂觀時期（90 年代末網際網路／技術基礎設施，今日 AI 基礎設施）。1997 年因亞洲金融危機經歷約 12% 修正（10 月 27 日單日約 7% 下跌），較短暫，數月內恢復，牛市持續。當前（2026 年 11 月中）規模類似，納斯達克綜合指數於 10 月 6 日見頂近 27,600，至 11 月初下跌約 12%，上週有單日 +6% 下跌；觸發因素為對 AI 數據中心／GPU 支出回報的質疑及高估值。快速技術變革期間此類修正較常見。認為仍處於 90 年代末，大泡沫尚未到來。2026 年納斯達克 100 遠期本益比約 19-23，對比 1997 年約 24-26；真正極端估值（倍數遠超 40-50）出現在 1999-2000 年。

en.text: $NDX Both the 1997 Nasdaq pullback and the current one happened during high optimism around a major technology wave (internet/tech infrastructure late ’90s, AI infrastructure today). 1997 saw ~12% correction (single-day ~7% drop on Oct 27) triggered by Asian financial crisis, short-lived, recovered in months, bull market continued. Current (mid-Nov 2026) similar size, Nasdaq Composite peaked near 27,600 on Oct 6, fell ~12% by early Nov, +6% single-day drop last week; trigger internal questions on AI data center/GPU spending returns and high valuations. Corrections common during rapid tech change. Believes still in late 1990s, big bubble still coming. 2026 Nasdaq 100 forward PE around 19-23 vs 1997 around 24-26; extreme valuations (multiples >40-50) came in 1999-2000.

zh.text: 相對國債僅多一點點收益率卻承擔重大下行風險，這不是補償，而是自滿。$JOJO提供更聰明的信用投資方法。

en.text: A sliver of extra yield over Treasuries for significant downside risk is not compensation, that is complacency. $JOJO offers a smarter approach to credit.

zh.text: 我在觀察的…… 👀 不是預測或投資／交易建議，只是觀察。$DXY pr

en.text: What I'm watching... 👀 Not a prediction or investment/trading advice--just an observation. $DXY pr

zh.text: 油價因地緣政治風險飆升。關稅不確定性無處不在。衰退機率上升。$JOJO 尊重信號，而非敘事。

en.text: Oil prices surging on geopolitical risk. Tariff uncertainty everywhere. Recession odds climbing. $JOJO respects the signal, not the narrative.

zh.text: #Lutnick #corruptaf（引用 CNBC：Cantor Fitzgerald 報告的 Nvidia 持股數量在 2025 年 9 月至 2026 年 3 月間幾乎減半。那是 Axios 報告商務部長 Howard Lutnick 面臨行政官員壓力以解決涉嫌走私 Nvidia 先進 AI 芯片到中國的時期。該公司以前由 Lutnick 擔任主席，現由其兒子經營，與 Nvidia 保持廣泛商業聯繫。）

en.text: #Lutnick #corruptaf (Quoted CNBC: Cantor Fitzgerald’s reported Nvidia share count fell by nearly half between September 2025 and March 2026. That was the period when Axios reported Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faced pressure from administration officials to address suspected smuggling of Nvidia’s advanced AI chips to China. The firm, formerly chaired by Lutnick and now run by his sons, maintained extensive commercial ties to Nvidia.)

zh.text: 許多人本年大幅虧損，尤其若重倉 AI 板塊過去一個月受挫。投資組合一直波動，對標普 500 或 ETF 不感興趣。現時六位數投資組合，大幅波動（上下六位數）促使重新思考管理。仍為長線投資者，不恐慌，若相信業務則持有長線，短線通常快速止損。改變：不會全押一隻股票；多取利潤並保留現金；關注其他板塊，從 AI 稍作分散，因負面頭條可觸發板塊拋售。因金額更大需更好管理風險。非投資建議。

en.text: Many down significantly this year, especially if heavily in AI sector hit over past month. Portfolio always volatile, not interested in S&P 500 or ETFs. Now with six-figure portfolio, large swings (up/down six figures) make rethink management. Still long-term investor, not panicking, hold long-term if believe in business, cut short-term losses quickly. Changes: won't go all-in on one stock; take more profits and keep cash; look at other sectors, diversify a little from AI as negative headlines trigger sector sell-offs. Manage risks better with larger amounts. NFA.
